home.text: Home About Events Products ITS Systems Services References Contacts Innovative ITS solutions for Public Transport DISCOVER MORE About Metatronix METATRONIX is a company focused on ITS systems for Local Public Transport with over 20 years of experience in providing solutions, products and services to leading bus manufacturers and transport operators. Quality is a key point for METATRONIX which is Automotive IATF 16949 and ISO 9001 certified. Metatronix is also a member of the ITxPT association and actively participates in technical working groups for the definition of standards for ITS systems applied to Public Transport. More than 80.000 Buses equipped with Metatronix ECUs. Solutions Automotive Electronics A large portfolio of made in Italy and off-the-shelf electronic components expertly customized to meet multiple ITS needs. View more ITS Solutions Design and implementation of customized on-board architectures and back-office systems according to ITxPT standards. View more Services Saas (Software as a Service), SoP (Software on Premise), HW and SW O.S.I. (On-Site Interventions), are our added value. View more Events Products MPPxPT On-board computer & Communication Gateway A new scalable on-board platform concept to provide multiple ITS services, standard ITxPT or developed by Metatronix. It can integrate an Ethernet Switch with 2 Gbps and 8 Mps ports and 2 OABR ports. D-Switch Automotive Ethernet Switches A range of 8-port Ethernet switches designed specifically for the automotive market to create an on-board LAN to connect all ITS devices, such as on-board computers, e-ticketing, video surveillance, P.I.S., etc. M-Switch Managed Automotive Ethernet Switches A range of 10-port Managed Ethernet switches designed specifically for the automotive market to create and manage on-board LAN to connect all ITS devices, such as on-board computers, e-ticketing, video surveillance, P.I.S., etc. A-DSP & A-DSPN Amplifier & Audio Dispatcher Designed to support ITS such as Passenger Information System (P.I.S.), announcement of next stop (internal and external), driver microphone and tour guide, multimedia entertainment. Integrated digital audio management. FMS Gateway FMS Gateway CAN interface Secure FMS Gateway which allows to make available CAN J1939 data of the vehicle. Available in standard version and with Ethernet interface and integrated FMS to IP service labelled by ITxPT.
